title: Unicode Support within SFML
body:
Every C++ dev will agree that unicode support for C++ is a pain, inconsistent across platforms and non-trivial to get right.

SFML has places where proper unicode support is lacking. This issue serves as a catch-all for this topic, so we can more easily see what has been fixed and what remains open.

## Unicode Path Handling

- [x] `sf::Image::saveToFile()` / `sf::Image::loadFromFile()` / `sf::Texture::loadFromFile()`
    - Issue: #647 
    - PR: #3403 
- [x] `sf::SoundBuffer::saveToFile()`
    - PR: #3421
- [x] `sf::SoundBuffer::loadFromFile()`
    - Tests: #3416
- [x] `sf::Shader::loadFromFile()`
    - Tests: #3410
- [x] `sf::Music::openFromFile()`
    - Tests: #3416
- [x] `sf::Font::openFromFile()`
    - PR: #3422 
- [x] `sf::InputSoundFile::openFromFile()` 
    - Tests: #3415
- [x] `sf::OutputSoundFile::openFromFile()`
   - Tests: #3419
   - PR: #3421
- [ ] `sf::Ftp` ?
- [x] `sf::FileInputStream` 
    - Tests: #3413

## Unicode Rendering

- [x] Complex Text Layout
    - Issue: #246
    - PR: #3543
- [ ] Font fallback
    - Issue: #1536
- [ ] Multi-texture rendering
    - Note: Prerequisite for font fallback support
    - PR: #2282
- [ ] Emoji support & colored fonts support

## Unicode String Handling

- [ ] Correct conversion
    - Issue: #407 
- [x] `sf::Utf<8>` handling
    - Comment: https://github.com/SFML/SFML/issues/3406#issuecomment-2625052363
- [ ] Invalid sequence handling
    - Comment: https://github.com/SFML/SFML/issues/3406#issuecomment-2625052363
- [ ] Consider replacing SFML unicode conversion with cpp-unicodelib
- [x] `sf::Clipboard`
    - PR: #3435
- [ ] `sf::String::String(wchar_t)` allows for constructing from one half of a UTF-16 surrogate pair
- [x] `sf::WindowBase::setTitle`
    - PR: https://github.com/SFML/SFML/pull/3437
